messages.subject: Progression of a plot
parts:
Hey there. I saw some worked example where it is possible to show the progression of a function (using shiny-incubator). Is there similar way to "upload" a plot in a shiny app??
Particularly I would like to show the progression of a plot, adding new data points (eg script below)

plot(0, 0, xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), col = "white")
for (j in 1:50) {
  Sys.sleep(0.1)
  points(runif(1, -1, 1), runif(1, -1, 1))
}

After that I would like to make it dynamic, letting the user to change some parameters (like the number of pairs points (50)), but first I need to figure out how to solve the first problem.
Any help is more than welcome.
Cheers,
Alessio
